scenario: G5 — Sparse data and partial coverage
note: Hand-computed once and frozen. Changing a figure here requires a PR comment explaining why the previously verified number was wrong (TESTING.md §5).

fixture.note: Two of four holdings can be priced. One is stale by the ten-day backstop. A manual asset is held but unvalued at this date, and a USD manual asset has no exchange rate at all — both basis-independent exclusions.

cost.note: Investments contribute acquisition cost: 400,000 + 300,000 + 500,000 + 100,000. Cash 500,000 + 700,000 (2,000,000 opening less 1,300,000 of purchases). Flat 8,000,000.
cost.coverageNote: Component-count coverage truncates at RATE_SCALE (7/9, 5/9); the value-weighted investment ratio rounds half_up. Phase 5 behaviour, unchanged.

market.note: EQ_A 400 × 1,100 = 440,000 and EQ_B 300 × 1,050 = 315,000 are priced; the bond and the mutual fund are excluded and named. The total is NOT 10,055,000 — that would be part market value and part acquisition cost, a figure in no basis at all.

restatement.note: −600,000 of unpriced cost set aside, no currency term (every priced holding is INR), and +55,000 of price movement: (440,000 − 400,000) + (315,000 − 300,000).
